question: What qualities make a son both good and a purifier of his family?
premises: Following the command of both parents is a defining conduct.
Such conduct characterizes a good son.
A good son brings purity to his family.
inference: A son who follows the commands of his parents is a good son and purifies his family.
plain_english: One who follows the commands of his parents is a good son and a purifier of the family.
